Bounsweet

Grass

Alola · Generation 7

Bounsweet is a Grass-type Fruit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.2 kg. It evolves into Steenee. Its highest base stat is HP (42), with a base stat total of 210.
